name: French Bread
subtitle: By the Cafeteria Lady
time: ~2 hr 45 min, ~30 min hands-on (mostly rising; estimated)

items: 5 cups bread flour (may use regular flour)

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Combine in mixer with dough hook: **5 cups bread flour** (may use regular flour), **1 Tbsp salt**, **2 Tbsp sugar** and **2 Tbsp yeast**.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add: **1 Tbsp oil or melted margarine** and **2½ cups warm water**.

steps.title: Add more flour
steps.body: Mix and add up to **2 cups more flour** until the dough doesn’t stick to the sides of the bowl when the mixer is running. Mix about 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Shape the loaves
steps.body: Mix again in a mixer for about 5 minutes. Shape into loaves and place on greased pan/s.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.body: Let rise again until about double. May brush with egg-white and water.
